- [ ] `refactor` — code change that neither fixes a bug nor adds a feature
- [ ] `test` — adding or correcting tests
- [ ] `build` — build system or dependency changes
- [ ] `ci` — CI/CD configuration changes
- [ ] `chore` — anything else (tooling, cleanup, etc.)

**PR title**: please use [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/) format — see [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md). It's used verbatim to generate the changelog when a release is cut.

**Cutting a release?** Title this PR `Release-vX.Y.Z` instead of the above — merging it triggers the release workflow (tag, changelogs, GitHub Release) for everything merged since the last release.
